process_nodes.note: Mature processes, mainly for MEMS force sensors, with analog and ASIC platforms planned.

summary: The first of two planned fabs in Zengxin Technology's 300 mm MEMS and mature-node project in Guangzhou's Zengcheng district. The company plans CNY 37 billion over five years for 120,000 wafers a month across both fabs; the first phase of FAB1, at CNY 7 billion and 20,000 wafers a month, began line connection and production on 28 June 2024, and its first product wafer came off the line on 10 August 2024.

location.site: Zengcheng Economic and Technological Development Zone, Zengcheng District

notes: The cited source splits the 120,000-wafer plan into FAB1 Phase 1 (20,000), FAB1 Phase 2 (40,000) and a second fab (60,000); only FAB1 Phase 1 is reported as producing. The record rests on one trade-press report; no operator or government source could be opened for it, and ownership is not stated there.

review.method: Independent AI-assisted review (Claude): re-opened every cited source, checked each statement against it and searched for newer reporting.
review.changes: Corrected the summary (the first product wafer came off the line, it was not reported shipped), named the development zone, added the FAB1 Phase 2 capacity and the end-2025 output target, and noted that the project comprises two fabs. No newer reporting was found.
